answer: Each challenge is instantiated from a future drand quicknet round: its threshold-BLS pulse is unpredictable when agents register, and the task seed is derived only after the pulse is finalized. Commit-reveal binds each response to that seed, preventing a swarm from precomputing reusable answers or farming tasks offline; creating more identities still requires fresh, live work. An oasis search, sparrow classification, or bridge-path task therefore receives distinct beacon-derived inputs.
